env._comment_beta_unlock: MUST stay 'false' on any profile that can reach the App Store. CORRECTED 2026-09-19: the EAS 'production' environment used to set EXPO_PUBLIC_BETA_UNLOCK_ALL=true, so a profile that forgot to pin it inherited TRUE and shipped with no paywall. The default is now 'false' on EAS, so forgetting to pin yields a LOCKED build. REMOVED 2026-10-14: the 'internal' profile that pinned 'true' (paid screens are reviewed by giving the test account pro|active in public.subscriptions, as the App Review account is) — no profile in this file may set it 'true'. Keep pinning anyway, and BETA_UNLOCK_ALL makes useBillingLimits report every user as 'pro' AND skip RevenueCat entirely (src/hooks/useBillingLimits.ts:102). This profile has a submit config with the same ascAppId as 'store', so it is a shippable path — before 2026-07-27 it would have shipped a build where the paywall did not exist.

env._comment_apk: Installable-on-device twin of the 'store' profile. 'store' emits an .aab, which Play needs but adb cannot install, and 'preview' emits an .apk but does NOT pin EXPO_PUBLIC_BETA_UNLOCK_ALL — so it inherits true from the EAS 'production' environment and the paywall silently disappears. Testing the real shipping config on a device needs both: apk output AND the flag pinned false. No autoIncrement, so smoke-testing does not burn Play version codes.
